verdict.rationale: Kling documents native audio co-generation of sound effects and ambient sound alongside the video, introduced in Kling 2.6, so the audio is produced with the scene in the same tool. A priced 'with audio' generation tier and the claim of an 'immersive audio-visual experience' back this up. Missing for 10: any evidence of music generation, detail on how well audio matches the scene or what control the user has over it, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond the vendor's own claims.
